en: Colored vintage postcard showing a town at the foot of a forested hill or mountain. In the foreground there are several light‑colored, two‑story buildings with classical facades and sloped roofs, surrounded by trees and smaller houses. In the background rises a steep, green hillside with a path or road cut across it and a rounded white structure or terrace near the top. Printed red text appears in the upper right corner of the image.
